channel.title: Paksh: Politics
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: US Midterm Elections: Democrats Face Potential Setbacks
item.description: Ahead of the US midterm elections, Democratic strategists are concerned that anything less than a significant victory, termed a 'blue wave,' could be perceived as a loss. One Republican pollster suggests that such a wave might still occur… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Matthew McConaughey hints at independent political run
item.description: Actor Matthew McConaughey has indicated a potential interest in running for political office as an independent. He suggested he might encourage independent voters to participate in the electoral process. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: South Korea to Withdraw Ukraine Embassy Staff Amid POW Dispute
item.description: South Korea announced it will withdraw some staff from its embassy in Ukraine following a dispute over the handling of prisoners of war (POWs). The specific number of staff to be withdrawn and the exact nature of the dispute were not… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Trump Declines to Endorse Vance's Stance on Netanyahu
item.description: Donald Trump did not commit to endorsing JD Vance's position regarding Israeli leader Benjamin Netanyahu. Vance himself refrained from endorsing Netanyahu. Trump, however, offered praise for Netanyahu. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Ken Griffin calls Trump tariffs a disaster, predicts Republican midterm losses
item.description: Hedge fund billionaire Ken Griffin described former President Donald Trump's tariffs on U.S. allies as a "disaster" that he predicts will harm Republicans in the midterm elections. The Wall Street Journal's opinion section also carried… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Romania Swears In New Government After Political Deadlock
item.description: Romania has sworn in a new prime minister and cabinet, concluding a period of political deadlock that lasted for months. The new government, described as pro-European, received approval from the Romanian parliament. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: World Leaders Trade Barbs at UN and in Brazil Debate
item.description: At the United Nations, the United States and Cuba exchanged sharp criticisms ahead of a vote on sanctions. In Brazil, presidential candidates Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Jair Bolsonaro engaged in their first debate, just days before the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: US Republicans Downplay Trump in Midterm Ads
item.description: Ahead of the US midterm elections, Republican political advertisements are notably downplaying or scrubbing references to former President Donald Trump. This strategic shift suggests a move away from direct association with Trump in… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: Trump suggests data center companies pay community dividends
item.description: Former US President Donald Trump proposed that data center companies should pay a "dividend" to local communities to increase the popularity of their projects. He stated that these companies must also generate their own power and either… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Trump's First Press Secretary Departs After Five Days
item.description: Stephanie Grisham, Donald Trump's first White House press secretary, departed the role after serving for five days. Her tenure was marked by a brief press briefing that lasted less than 15 minutes. Her predecessor, Katie Zacharia… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated that the United States has resumed intelligence sharing with Kyiv, a system he described as an early warning for Russian missile attacks. Zelenskyy indicated this change followed discussions… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: Government Expected to Announce DA Hike for Central Employees
item.description: Central government employees and pensioners are awaiting an announcement regarding a Dearness Allowance (DA) hike. Expectations were that the government might announce the July DA hike before Dussehra, but attention has now shifted to a… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: RSS Chief Mohan Bhagwat: No Regime Change in India
item.description: RSS chief Mohan Bhagwat stated that there will be no "regime change" in India, adding that attempts are being made to create situations similar to those in Bangladesh and France. Bhagwat made these remarks after performing 'Shastra Puja'. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: India opposes UN 'unverified allegations' on protests
item.description: India has opposed the use of "unverified allegations" to negatively portray the country at the UN General Assembly's Third Committee. Deputy Secretary Barkha Tamrakar stated that India opposes turning such allegations into a negative… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Ex-IMF Director Disputes Pakistan's World Bank Leadership Claim
item.description: An ex-International Monetary Fund (IMF) director has challenged Pakistan's assertion of a 'historic' leadership role with the World Bank. The claim, which Pakistan presented as a significant achievement, was described as being based on… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Youth Congress Protests Against CEC, Burns Effigy
item.description: The Youth Congress staged a protest in Delhi, burning an effigy of Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) Rajiv Kumar. In Chandigarh, the Congress party also burned an effigy of the CEC. The protests involved burning a Ravana effigy adorned… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Indonesian students protest government policies
item.description: Students in Indonesia have taken to the streets to protest against the policies of President Prabowo's government. The demonstrations are related to issues including the cost of living and forest fires. Protests have also occurred in… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Trump's New Mexico Name Change Proposal Draws Criticism
item.description: Former U.S. President Donald Trump has again proposed renaming the U.S. state of New Mexico to "New America," claiming this would lead to increased incomes. The governor of New Mexico responded to Trump's proposal. Reports indicate that a… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 2.

item.title: India Rejects UN Human Rights Claims as Political Pressure
item.description: India has rejected claims made at the UN Human Rights Council, stating that human rights should not be used for political pressure or to portray the country negatively through unverified allegations. This response comes as UN experts… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: West Bengal Makes 'Ramayana' Film Tax-Free
item.description: West Bengal Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari announced that the film 'Ramayana' has been made tax-free in the state. The announcement was made on Dussehra. The film stars Ranbir Kapoor and Yash. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Jagan Reddy Expresses Regret Over Election Commissioner Appointment Law
item.description: Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister Y.S. Jagan Mohan Reddy has expressed regret over the YSRCP's support for the 2023 law concerning the appointment of Election Commissioners. YSRCP leaders stated that their support for the NDA government has… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Jaishankar, US, UAE Ministers Meet in Mumbai on Trade, Energy, West Asia
item.description: India's External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar met with US Secretary of State Marco Rubio and UAE Minister Sheikh Abdullah bin Zayed Al Nahyan in Mumbai. The discussions focused on trade deals, defense cooperation, the West Asia crisis… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: EU Launches New Arctic Strategy Amid Security and Climate Concerns
item.description: The European Union has unveiled a new strategy for the Arctic region, emphasizing security and addressing global warming. The strategy aims to boost the EU's presence and engagement in the Arctic. It acknowledges the growing importance of… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 6 · Right 0.

item.title: Activist claims potential detention ahead of 'Tiranga' march
item.description: Abhijeet Dipke stated he is prepared to go to jail and anticipates potential detention before a planned 'Tiranga' march. The march is scheduled to take place at Connaught Place. Coverage: Left 3 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Odisha CM Questions BJP on Andhra Pradesh Election Notice in Disputed Villages
item.description: Odisha Chief Minister Naveen Patnaik has questioned the Bharatiya Janata Party's (BJP) silence regarding an election notice issued by Andhra Pradesh in the Kotia villages, which are subject to a long-standing dispute between the two… Coverage: Left 3 · Centre 0 · Right 0.

item.title: US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth Visits Israel, Meets Netanyahu
item.description: US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth made an unannounced visit to Israel where he reportedly met with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. The visit took place in the Middle East. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Maine Senate Debate Features Clashes on Iran, Prices, and Protests
item.description: The final televised debate for the Maine US Senate race saw incumbent Republican Senator Susan Collins and Democratic challenger Angus King clash over issues including Iran and consumer prices. A protester interrupted the debate, shouting… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 6 · Right 1.

item.title: Iran rejects moving enriched uranium abroad, tells Pakistan army chief
item.description: Iran's security chief stated that the country will not permit any enriched nuclear material to leave its territory. This declaration was made to Pakistan's army chief, Asim Munir, who was in Tehran as part of Pakistan's efforts to mediate… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 4.

item.title: US visa issuances halved under Trump administration
item.description: The Trump administration has revoked over 300,000 visas during its second term as part of an immigration crackdown and deportation drive aimed at improving domestic security. Legal immigration to the US has fallen by half, from 52,000 to… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: US Bans Chinese AI Tools from Government Systems
item.description: The United States government has banned the use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools developed by the Chinese startup DeepSeek by its agencies. The Department of Defense stated that the use of these tools could result in the transfer of… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 4 · Right 1.

item.title: Canadian PM Warns of US Interference Ahead of Alberta Independence Vote
item.description: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney warned on Thursday that the United States is attempting to "break Canada" ahead of a vote on whether Alberta should begin the legal process toward separation from the country. Carney stated his… Coverage: Left 5 · Centre 16 · Right 0.

item.title: US Envoy to Meet Putin After Talks with Ukraine's Zelenskiy
item.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy is seeking a meeting with the leaders of Russia and the United States. This comes after talks in Oslo involving the US envoy and Zelenskiy. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: Morocco and Iraq Face New Governance Challenges
item.description: Morocco's government is confronting new challenges, while Iraq is facing its own set of difficulties as US troops withdraw. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Justice Kagan Criticizes Supreme Court's Impact on Democracy
item.description: Justice Elena Kagan has stated that recent rulings by the Supreme Court have damaged democracy. She warned that these decisions are fueling polarization and undermining the democratic process. Kagan's remarks indicate a concern about the… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Macron Tours Gulf Amid French Fuel Price Protests
item.description: French President Emmanuel Macron began a tour of Gulf nations seeking solutions to soaring fuel prices, a trip that followed violent protests in France. The protests were linked to the rising cost of fuel. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Democrats Question Pentagon's 'True Cost' of Iran War
item.description: Democratic senators are demanding the Pentagon disclose the "true cost" of a potential war in Iran, emphasizing that such a conflict would extend beyond economic impacts like gas prices. The senators' concerns highlight a broader debate… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Alberta Referendum Sees High Turnout Amidst Voter Access Concerns
item.description: First Nations leaders have praised the high turnout in an Alberta referendum, despite concerns raised by officials about ballot box barriers that caused delays for some Indigenous voters. The referendum saw significant participation, with… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Suu Kyi Receives Package from King Charles III in Myanmar
item.description: Aung San Suu Kyi, Myanmar's detained former leader, has received a package from King Charles III. The Myanmar government confirmed this development, according to reports. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Chancellor Rules Out Capital Gains Tax Increases
item.description: Chancellor John Healey has rejected calls to raise Capital Gains Tax (CGT) in the upcoming budget. Influential Labour figures had advocated for equalizing CGT with income tax rates, but concerns were raised that such a move could lead to… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.
